page.layout: One printed page: title block at the top (centred, capitals and roman type), a short italic paragraph beneath it, a woodcut vignette of a tree with a figure in a landscape, and the imprint at the foot.

main_text.l: Deinde in Epitomen redacta & novorum Li-
brorū accessione locupletata, jam vero po-
stremo recognita, & in duplum post priores editiones aucta, per Iosiam

l.i: HABES hic, optime Lector, catalogum locupletissimum omnium
fere scriptorum, à mundi initio ad hunc vsq; diem, extantium & non
extantium, publicatorum & passim in Bibliothecis latitantium. Opus
non Bibliothecis tantum publicis privatisue instituendis necessarium,
sed studiosis omnibus, cuiuscunq; artis aut scientiæ, ad studia melius

page.notes: Woodcut vignette between the italic paragraph and the place of printing: a tree with spreading foliage, a seated or reclining figure at its base, a town with a church spire in the distance. No text in it. Spelling corrected by rule: "novorum", "jam", "privatisue", "utilissimum", "VERUM", "TIGURI" (u/v). "vsq;" kept as printed. The imprint's dot after "FROSCHO" and the period after "VERUM" are printer's ornaments or stops, kept as a plain stop. The line "M. D. LXXIIII." is printed with stops and spaces, kept as printed. Scan is slightly rubbed at the right edge; no words lost.
